user.title: pCloud Backup Configuration
user.description: Enter your pCloud credentials and select your datacenter region.

folder_path.title: Configure Backup Folder
folder_path.description: Enter the folder path in pCloud where backups will be stored. The folder will be created if it doesn't exist. Set upload timeout for large backups over slow uplinks.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate pCloud
reauth_confirm.description: pCloud no longer accepts the stored access token (for example because app access was removed or the password was changed). Sign in to the same pCloud account again so backups keep working.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to pCloud. Please check your credentials and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please check your email and password.
error.invalid_folder_path: Invalid folder path. Please check the path and try again. The folder will be created if it doesn't exist.

abort.already_configured: This pCloud account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in to a different pCloud account. Sign in with the account this integration was set up with.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to pCloud. Please try again later.

init.title: pCloud Backup Options
init.description: Configure the backup folder path in pCloud and upload timeout for large backups.
